title: A whole village stirred by one household
odia:
ଅପାଇ ପାଇଚି ପିଲା,
ନା ଗାଁ ଯାକ କିଲିବିଲା...!!!
literal_meaning: Apai has got a child; the whole village is in a commotion.
explanation: A private event becomes everybody’s noisy business. The source introduces this saying as something used when someone makes too much of a display. Its joke lies in the size of the response: one household’s news seems to shake an entire village.
meaning_odia: ଜଣଙ୍କ ଘରେ ପିଲା ହେବାର ଖବର, ଅଥଚ ଗାଁ ସାରା କିଲିବିଲି। ନିଜ କଥାକୁ ନେଇ ଅତିରିକ୍ତ ଦେଖେଇ ହେଲେ ଏହି ଉକ୍ତିରେ ପରିହାସ କରାଯାଏ। ଛୋଟ ପରିସରର ଘଟଣାକୁ ବଡ଼ ହୋହଲ୍ଲା କରିଦେବାର ତୁଳନାଟି ଏହାକୁ ମନେ ରଖାଏ।
usage_example: A small household purchase is announced repeatedly to every neighbour, with more ceremony than the occasion seems to need. (Original imagined occasion.)
cultural_context: The source explicitly supplies a display/show-off context. Apai is retained as an unidentified source designation; no historical person, kinship role or gender is inferred. The criticism is of disproportionate display, not of celebrating a child.
odia_summary: ନିଜ ଘରର ଖବରକୁ ଗାଁ ସାରା ହୋହଲ୍ଲା କରିଦେବାକୁ ଏହି ଉକ୍ତି ପରିହାସ କରେ।
english_summary: One household’s news turns into a village-wide commotion: a joke about excessive display.
